items.title: Edgar Wright Says New AI Remaster of Cult TV Comedy 'Spaced' Is a 'Bummer': 'Not Authorized by Anyone Involved in Making the Show'
items.excerpt: A new AI-upscaled 4K Blu-ray release of the cult British comedy Spaced has sparked backlash, with director Edgar Wright saying the AI remaster was not authorized by anyone involved in making the show.

items.title: Cate Blanchett-Backed Group and Collection of Hollywood Stars File Brief in New York Times' OpenAI Lawsuit
items.excerpt: The Human Consent Foundation, joined by CAA, the National Association of Voice Actors and a roster of Hollywood stars, filed a 31-page amicus brief arguing an AI-training licensing market for creative work and likenesses already exists.

items.title: WME Joins New York Times Copyright Battle Against OpenAI
items.excerpt: In an amicus brief filed Oct. 30, WME argues AI use of creative materials should not be stopped but licensed, with compensation and authorization for talent whose work or likeness is used.

items.title: China's First AI Feature Earns Just $253,000 In 11 Days
items.excerpt: 'Sanxingdui: Future Past', billed as China's first fully AI-generated theatrical feature, limped through its second weekend; it reportedly cost $1.5 million and forecasts suggest it won't gross a third of that. (Follow-up to the 10-27 opening-flop story.)

items.title: View Conference Was Inspiring: The AI Sales Pitches Were Exhausting (And Occasionally Bullshit)
items.excerpt: At Turin's View Conference, filmmakers shared craft while AI evangelists insisted everyone already uses generative tools; Cartoon Brew reports on the AI pitches from studios and vendors and the pushback from animation artists.

items.title: After Effects Portal October 2026
items.excerpt: Monthly After Effects roundup: Artcraft's vibe-coded AE clone EffectCraft paired with AI assistants and MCP, Firefly Boards animation tests versus hand-made AE work, and other AI and third-party motion tools.

items.title: He Didn't Even Do Anything!! (CorridorKey 2.0 neural keyer)
items.excerpt: Corridor Crew demos CorridorKey 2.0, its neural green/blue-screen keyer now released as a one-purchase plugin for Resolve, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere and Blender (beta pricing to Nov 20, full release Nov 21); built for 400+ VFX shots on 'Son of a Dungeon'.

items.title: Adobe MAX 2026 preview: keynotes and Sneaks
items.excerpt: Adobe MAX 2026 runs Nov 10-12 in Miami Beach; RedShark previews keynote times, Sneaks and the standout video and audio sessions, where Firefly and Premiere AI updates are expected.

items.title: 영화 각본도 챗GPT가 쓴다…일본, 전편 생성형 AI 장편영화 2027년 공개
items.excerpt: Japanese producers (Oxons, Tender Pro) announced 'Jikū Yūkaku Labyrinth', a feature made entirely with generative AI -- ChatGPT-written script, AI-recreated likenesses of three real actors, Suno theme song -- slated for 2027. Off-list: no allowed-domain coverage found.

items.title: 대전 2인 제작진의 AI 영화, 뉴욕 영화제 수상…인간이 연출하고 AI가 영상 구현
items.excerpt: Daejeon two-person Studio UNMU's 11-minute AI sci-fi short 'LAST CALL' won an Honorable Mention for Best AI-Generated or Assisted Film at New York's 30th Urbanworld Film Festival; humans scripted, directed, edited and mixed while generative AI rendered the imagery. Off-list.

items.title: iQIYI opens AI film studio in Shanghai, starts first production
items.excerpt: iQIYI opened an AI film studio at its Shanghai Creative Center and began production of its first project there, the internet feature film 'Cop in Trouble' (announced Oct 28). Off-list: technode.com had no coverage.

items.title: Idris Elba, Google launch free AI filmmaking programme in five African countries
items.excerpt: Akuna Learning, from Idris Elba's Akuna Group, and Google opened applications for a free AI filmmaking programme with production funding for emerging creators in five African countries (applications to Nov 15). Off-list: no allowed-domain coverage found.

items.title: AI Film Festival Japan Draws 730 Entries From More Than 60 Countries
items.excerpt: AI Film Festival Japan 2026 (Oct 31-Nov 2, Tokyo Innovation Base) drew 730+ entries from 60+ countries, screened 68 and named winners at its Nov 1 ceremony, including NTV AX-ON's Ayano Kotakagari in a new AI Film Music category. Off-list; grand prix not named in article. Date from page (Nov 02 JST) / feed time.
